{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "supportive of testing against recent Taproot-heavy blocks and offered to provide an assumeutxo snapshot"
    },
    {
      "login": "0xB10C",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "benchmarked IBD showing batch validation was slower than master"
    },
    {
      "login": "willcl-ark",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "collaborated on benchmarks and noted lack of fallback mechanism in early WIP"
    },
    {
      "login": "andrewtoth",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to shared batch mutex contention and suggested per-thread batches"
    },
    {
      "login": "Eunovo",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out shared batch lock contention, verification inside critical sections, and ignored pubkey parse return values"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:2106968575",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "batch validation caused significant performance regressions during IBD compared to master",
      "quote": "master is currently faster... after taproot activation, batch validation is significantly slower than non-batch validation",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2889288127"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:2889288127",
      "settled_by_quote": "I have implemented this and see a performance boost from it for the case with 15 worker threads"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2525335080",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "holding a shared batch mutex during addition and verifying on the main thread negated multithreading benefits",
      "quote": "m_batch_mutex is held for the entirety of adding, which will cause lock contention. Verify is then a blocking call on the main thread, which negates the multithreading.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2004525996",
        "rc:2009282526"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2009282526",
      "settled_by_quote": "I have now implemented it with a batch per thread using a flag set in complete as you suggested."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1997877541",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "sharing a single batch across threads caused worker threads to block waiting for batch access",
      "quote": "All the threads still share this batch. That means we still have the same locking problem; threads will be stuck waiting for the batch to be free.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2004525996",
        "rc:2009282526"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2009282526",
      "settled_by_quote": "I have now implemented it with a batch per thread using a flag set in complete as you suggested."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2851542917",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "performing batch verification inside the critical section caused throughput to degrade as thread count increased",
      "quote": "Doing batch-verification work within the critical section",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2889288127"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:2965616244",
      "settled_by_quote": "It seems like the major reason for performance drop was the batch-verification work being performed in the critical section."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2148806441",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "discarding the return value of pubkey parsing risks ignoring invalid public keys",
      "quote": "why discard the return value of secp256k1_xonly_pubkey_parse()?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2727489972"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2727489972",
      "settled_by_quote": "Not discarding it anymore in the latest push."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:1968590438",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "highlighted potential performance benefits on recent Taproot-heavy mainnet blocks and offered an assumeutxo snapshot to facilitate testing",
      "substantive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1997499892",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "noted the architecture sets up well for future batch taproot tweak verification",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial assessment completed. Performance regressions and lock contention identified by 0xB10C, andrewtoth, and Eunovo led to an architectural overhaul utilizing per-thread batches verified outside critical sections. An ignored return value during pubkey parsing was also resolved."
}
